feat.yourDayAlreadyHasAShapeTheAppFollow: Your day already has a shape. The app follows it instead of fighting it.
feat.accurateTimesForYourLocationOneTapT: Accurate times for your location, one tap to log each prayer and whether it was on time. Streaks show your consistency at a glance.
feat.aQuietNudgeBeforeEachPrayerAndTheAd: A quiet nudge before each prayer, and the adhan when the time arrives. Set your own lead time, or quiet hours to hear nothing at all.
feat.morningAndEveningRemembranceWithACo: Morning and evening remembrance with a counter that keeps your place, so you can finish where you left off.

feat.consistencyBeatsAmbitionSoTheseAreD: Consistency beats ambition, so these are deliberately simple.
feat.dailyHabitsWithStreaksAndTwoGraceDa: Daily habits with streaks — and two grace days a month, so one missed day doesn’t erase weeks of effort.
feat.aPomodoroTimerWithOptionalAmbientSo: A Pomodoro timer with optional ambient sound. It runs on the wall clock, so it stays accurate even if you switch away.
feat.planTheDayWithPrioritiesDueDatesAnd: Plan the day with priorities, due dates and subtasks. Overdue work surfaces in the morning instead of getting buried.
feat.remindersYouControlStreaksThatForgi: Reminders you control, streaks that forgive, and no guilt-tripping when life gets in the way.
feat.seeHowTheWeekActuallyWent: See how the week actually went
feat.honestNumbersRatherThanVanityCharts: Honest numbers rather than vanity charts.
feat.gratitudeLessonsAndDuInOnePlaceDate: Gratitude, lessons and du‘ā in one place, dated in both calendars, with a mood you can look back on.
feat.trackWorldlyAndSpiritualGoalsSideBy: Track worldly and spiritual goals side by side, with milestones and progress, so the balance stays visible.
feat.trendsAcrossPrayersHabitsFocusAndTa: Trends across prayers, habits, focus and tasks — enough to spot a pattern, not so much that it becomes homework.
feat.aShortSundayEmailSummarisingYourWee: A short Sunday email summarising your week, with your streaks and on-time prayer rate.
feat.theInterfaceShiftsWithTheDayStillAn: The interface shifts with the day — still and blue at Fajr, warm at Asr, quiet after Isha.

quote.tawakkul: And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose.
quote.wayOut: And whoever fears Allah — He will make for him a way out.
quote.easeAfterHardship: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.
quote.rememberMe: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
quote.patiencePrayer: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
quote.capacity: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
quote.heartsAtRest: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
quote.sufficient: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
quote.bestGuardian: But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
quote.rewardNotLost: And be patient, for indeed Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.
quote.goodLife: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while being a believer — We will surely cause them to live a good life.
quote.striveGuided: And those who strive for Us — We will surely guide them to Our ways.
quote.thenStandUp: So when you have finished your duties, then stand up for worship.
quote.doNotDespair: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
quote.gratitudeIncrease: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favour.
quote.believersSucceed: Certainly will the believers have succeeded — they who are humbly submissive in their prayer.
quote.prayerForRemembrance: And establish prayer for My remembrance.
quote.byTime: By time — indeed, mankind is in loss.
quote.helpThroughPatience: And seek help through patience and prayer.
quote.everLiving: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
quote.consistentDeeds: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if they are few.
quote.fiveBeforeFive: Take advantage of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your illness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before your busyness, and your life before your death.
quote.benefitOthers: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.
quote.speakGoodOrSilent: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
quote.loveForBrother: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
quote.strongBeliever: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is good in both.
quote.looksAtHearts: Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
quote.strangerTraveler: Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a traveller along a path.
quote.fourQuestions: A servant’s feet will not move on the Day of Judgement until he is asked about his life and how he spent it, his knowledge and what he did with it, his wealth — how he earned and spent it — and his body and how he used it.
